repeat.title: Asking again feels hard? Let's try it.
repeat.phrase: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
repeat.tip_ua: Ця фраза працює з будь-яким акцентом і будь-яким начальником.

manager.title: Talking to your manager? Start with one line.
manager.phrase: Could I talk to you for a minute, please?
manager.tip_ua: «Please» в кінці робить прохання ввічливим, але не слабким.
manager.title_ua: Розмова з менеджером? Почни з однієї фрази.

phone.title: Phone calls are the hardest — no faces, no gestures.
phone.phrase: Hi, it's {name}. I'm calling to say I'll be late today.
phone.ua: Привіт, це {name}. Дзвоню сказати, що сьогодні запізнюся.
phone.tip_ua: Спершу ім'я, потім причина дзвінка — це все, що чекають у перші 5 секунд.
phone.title_ua: Дзвінки — найважче: ні облич, ні жестів.

smalltalk.title: Small talk on a break? Here's an easy start.
smalltalk.phrase: How was your weekend? Mine was quiet.
smalltalk.ua: Як минули вихідні? У мене спокійно.
smalltalk.tip_ua: Додай про себе одне речення — і розмова піде сама.
smalltalk.title_ua: Small talk на перерві? Ось легкий початок.

meetings.title: Missed something in the briefing? Ask like this.
meetings.phrase: Sorry, what do I need to do first?
meetings.ua: Вибачте, що мені треба зробити спочатку?
meetings.tip_ua: Питати про перший крок — це нормально, це звучить відповідально.
meetings.title_ua: Пропустила щось на брифінгу? Перепитай так.

services.title: Doctor, bank or school? Start with this.
services.phrase: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment, please.
services.ua: Добрий день, я хочу записатися на прийом.
services.tip_ua: «I'd like…» — універсальний початок для будь-якого запиту.
services.title_ua: Лікар, банк чи школа? Почни з цього.

none.title: Let's try it. Say this out loud:
none.phrase: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
none.tip_ua: Ця фраза працює з будь-яким акцентом і будь-яким начальником.

money.label: Earn more
money.title: People with limited English earn 25–40% less.
money.sub: Asking for more hours is a skill you can train.
money.title_ua: Люди з обмеженою англійською заробляють на 25–40% менше.
money.sub_ua: Просити більше годин — це навичка, яку можна натренувати.

promotion.label: Get noticed
promotion.title: Skilled people without confident English are twice as likely to work in jobs below their skills.
promotion.sub: Speaking up is how people get noticed. You can train it.
promotion.title_ua: Кваліфіковані люди без впевненої англійської вдвічі частіше працюють нижче своєї кваліфікації.
promotion.sub_ua: Говорити вголос — так тебе помічають. Це можна натренувати.

mistake.label: Stay safe
mistake.title: Employers say 1 in 4 workplace accidents could have been avoided without a language barrier.
mistake.sub: Knowing how to ask and report keeps you safe.
mistake.todo: TODO: потрібен рісерч — оригінальний звіт IOSH або HSE RR502
mistake.title_ua: Роботодавці кажуть: 1 з 4 нещасних випадків можна було б уникнути без мовного бар'єру.
mistake.sub_ua: Уміння спитати й повідомити береже тебе.

embarrassed.label: Speak up
embarrassed.title: 1 in 3 people have nodded along without understanding. You're not alone.
embarrassed.sub: Asking again is normal. We'll practise exactly how.
embarrassed.decision: Запасний варіант: KFF/LA Times 2023 — 53%, «More than half of people in your shoes have felt this.»
embarrassed.title_ua: 1 з 3 людей кивали, не розуміючи. Ти не одна.
embarrassed.sub_ua: Перепитати — нормально. Ми потренуємо, як саме.

none.title: Good — let's keep it that way.
none.sub: 5 minutes on your break, before the talk that matters.
how_lesson_works: Briefing — who you'll talk to and why
Talk — a real conversation with Veera
Phrases — save the lines you'll use tomorrow
none.sub_ua: 5 хвилин на перерві — перед розмовою, яка важлива.
how_ua: Брифінг — з ким говориш і навіщо
Фрази — збережи те, що скажеш завтра

repeat: You nod and pretend you understood
You ask again — calmly, in English
manager: You avoid asking your manager for things
Talking to your manager — you handle it yourself
phone: You text, or ask someone to call for you
smalltalk: You chat on breaks without planning every word
meetings: You miss part of the morning briefing
You know what to do after the briefing
services: You bring someone to translate at the doctor's
You book and explain things yourself

promotion: Someone else gets the better role
money: You don't ask for extra shifts
You ask for more hours with the right words
embarrassed: You stay silent a few times a week
You speak up, even when it's hard

now_in4.rule: Now = hardest_1 + cost (cost=none → hardest_2). In 4 weeks = hardest_1 + cost goal.

plan_rules.meetings_rule: meetings → C5 first in its block

none+daily_life.todo: TODO: у документі немає рядка для none + daily_life

factory_warehouse.hazard_1: A pallet is leaking oil on the floor

care.task_1: morning personal care for Mrs Brown
care.problem_1: The call bell in Room 4 isn't working
care.hazard_1: A resident has fallen in the bathroom

hospitality_retail.problem_1: A guest says their room wasn't cleaned
hospitality_retail.hazard_1: There's broken glass behind the bar

construction.problem_1: The delivery is missing half the blocks

other.hazard_1: A cable is across the walkway

office.hazard_1: A cable is across the walkway

not_working.hazard_1: A cable is across the walkway

substitutions_note: Ключі colleague, task_2, task_1_plain, quick_fix, thing, slang_hours, next_role_task, site, shift, sector_job — дописано дизайнером (їх немає в таблиці 6.1).

C1.title: Supervisor's instructions

briefing.who: {boss} gives you today's tasks at the start of the shift.
briefing.goal: Understand the first task and check one detail.

phrases: So first I need to go to {area_1}, right?
Тобто спочатку мені треба на {area_1}, так?
Where do I need to go?
Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
Who do I ask if I have a question?

ai.en: Morning! You're on {area_1} today.
Crack on with {task_1}, then give us a hand on {area_2} after break, yeah?
ai.ua: Починай з {task_1}, а після перерви допоможи на {area_2}, добре?

ai.en: Any questions?
Spot on. Shout if you need me.

me: Morning! So I'm on {area_1}?
Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
So first I need to go to {area_1}, right?

worked: «So first I need to go to {area_1}, right?»
You checked the task — that's what good workers do.

better.try: So first I need to go to {area_1}, right?
better.why_ua: «…, right?» в кінці перетворює фразу на перевірку — так звучить впевнено.

C2.title: Ask to repeat or slow down

briefing.who: {boss} speaks fast and you miss a word.
briefing.goal: Ask again without apologising too much.

phrases: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
So you mean I start on {area_1}?
Тобто ви маєте на увазі, що я починаю на {area_1}?

ai.en: Right, {slang_1} — {area_1}, sharpish, then {task_2}.
Sure. First, {task_1_plain}. Then {task_2}.
Got it?
Spot on. Off you go.

me: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
What does ‘{slang_1}’ mean?
So you mean I start on {area_1}?

worked: «Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?»
You asked instead of guessing.

better.try: Sorry, could you say that again?
better.why_ua: Одного «sorry» досить — так звучить спокійно, а не винувато.

designer: AI line 1: «on» → «—», щоб «crack on on» не дублювалось

C3.title: Ask a colleague for help

briefing.who: You're stuck with {task_hard}. {colleague} is nearby.
briefing.goal: Ask for help and say thank you.

phrases: Hey, have you got a minute?
Sorry, could you show me again?

ai.en: Yeah, what's up?
Oh, that? Easy — you just {quick_fix}, innit.
ai.ua: А, це? Легко — просто {quick_fix}, так же?

ai.en: Try it now. Better?
No worries, mate.

me: Hey, have you got a minute? How do I use {task_hard}?
Sorry, could you show me again?
Cheers, that really helps.

worked: «Hey, have you got a minute?»
You started politely, so people want to help.

better.try: Could you help me with this?
better.why_ua: «Could you…» звучить як прохання, а не як наказ.

C4.title: Call in sick or late

briefing.who: You're ill or your bus is late. You call {boss} before the shift.
briefing.goal: Say who you are, what happened, and when you'll come.

phrases: I'm sorry, I'm not well today and can't come in.
Вибачте, я хворію і не прийду
Sorry, the line is bad — could you repeat that?

ai.en: Hello, {site}.
Right, are you off sick, then? Have you filled in the absence thing on the app?
ai.ua: Так, ти на лікарняному? Ти заповнила форму відсутності в застосунку?

ai.en: When d'you reckon you'll be back?
OK, get well soon.

me: Hi, it's {name} from {shift}. I'm sorry, I'm not well today and can't come in.
Sorry, the line is bad — could you repeat that?
I think I'll be back on Monday.

worked: «Hi, it's {name} from {shift}.»
You said who you are in the first second — your manager doesn't have to guess.

better.try: I'm not well today, so I can't come in.
better.why_ua: «Can't come in» — стандартна фраза, коли не виходиш на зміну.

C5.title: Report a problem

briefing.who: {problem_1}.
briefing.goal: Tell {boss} what's wrong and where.

phrases: Sorry, what should I do now?
It happened about ten minutes ago.

ai.en: What's up?
Where exactly?
Right, leave it, I'll get maintenance to have a look. Crack on with {task_2} for now.
ai.ua: Добре, залиш, я покличу техніків. Поки займайся {task_2}.

me: There's a problem with {thing}. It's not working.
On {area_1}. It happened about ten minutes ago.
OK. Sorry, what should I do now?

worked: «There's a problem with {thing}.»
You said what and where — that's all your manager needs.

better.try: There's a problem with the machine on {area_1}.
better.why_ua: Що + де в одному реченні — і тобі відразу допоможуть.

C6.title: Swap a shift or ask for a day off

briefing.who: You need Friday off.
briefing.goal: Ask {boss} and offer a swap.

phrases: Could I have Friday off, please?
I can swap with {colleague} — they're OK with it.
Я можу помінятися з {colleague}, вони не проти
Sorry, do I need to put it on the rota?
Мені треба вписати це в графік?

ai.en: Friday? Bit short notice.
You'll need to stick a holiday request in, and sort cover.
ai.ua: Тобі треба подати заяву на відпустку і знайти заміну.

ai.en: Alright, if {colleague}'s happy, I'm happy.
ai.ua: Гаразд, якщо {colleague} не проти, то і я не проти.

me: Could I have Friday off, please?
I can swap with {colleague} — they're OK with it.
Sorry, do I need to put it on the rota?

worked: «I can swap with {colleague}.»
You offered a solution — managers say yes more often.

better.try: Could I have Friday off, please?
better.why_ua: «Could I have…, please?» — ввічливе прохання, а не вимога.

C7.title: Pay, overtime, payslip mistake

briefing.who: Your payslip is missing 6 hours of overtime.
briefing.goal: Explain the problem and agree what happens next.

phrases: I think there's a mistake on my payslip.
My overtime from last week isn't there.
Немає моїх понаднормових за минулий тиждень
Sorry, who do I need to talk to?

ai.en: What seems to be the problem?
Which week was it?
Right, I'll flag it with {payroll} — should be sorted in the next pay run.
ai.ua: Добре, я передам це в {payroll} — має виправитися в наступну виплату.

me: I think there's a mistake on my payslip. My overtime isn't there.
It was last week — six hours.
Thank you. When will it be fixed?

worked: «I think there's a mistake on my payslip.»
You named the problem calmly — that's how it gets fixed fast.

better.try: I think there's a mistake on my payslip.
better.why_ua: «Payslip» — так у UK називають розрахунковий лист.

C8.title: Ask for more hours

briefing.who: You want more shifts or a better shift.
briefing.goal: Ask clearly and give one reason.

phrases: Could I talk to you for a minute, please?
I'd like to pick up more hours, if there are any.
Я хотіла б більше годин, якщо є
Sorry, what do you mean by ‘{slang_hours}’?
I'm reliable and I know {area_1} well.
На мене можна покластися, і я добре знаю {area_1}

ai.en: Sure, what's on your mind?
Things are a bit tight at the mo, but there might be some overtime going on nights.
ai.ua: Зараз трохи туго, але можуть бути понаднормові на нічних.

ai.en: Would you be up for that?
Leave it with me.

me: Could I talk to you for a minute, please? I'd like to pick up more hours.
I'm reliable and I know {area_1} well.
Yes, nights are fine for me.

worked: «I'm reliable and I know {area_1} well.»
You gave a reason — that makes it easy to say yes.

better.try: I'd like to pick up more hours, if there are any.
better.why_ua: Проси години, а не гроші, — так звучить як пропозиція допомогти.

promotion.title: Ask for more responsibility
promotion.goal: Ask to learn more and train for {next_role}.
phrase: I'd like to learn {next_role_task}. Is there a chance to train for {next_role}?
Я хотіла б навчитися {next_role_task}. Чи є можливість навчитися на {next_role}?

C9.title: Small talk on a break

briefing.who: It's break time. {colleague} sits next to you.
briefing.goal: Keep the chat going for 3 turns.

phrases: Mine was quiet — I just rested.

ai.en: Alright? Busy one today.
Went to watch the footy Saturday, absolute shambles, we got battered.
ai.ua: У суботу ходив на футбол — повний провал, нас розгромили.

ai.en: You do anything nice?

me: Yeah, busy. How was your weekend?
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Really? What happened?
Mine was quiet — I just rested.

worked: «Really? What happened?»
You asked a question back — that's what keeps a chat going.

better.try: Mine was quiet — I just rested.
better.why_ua: Коротке речення про себе — і розмова йде далі.

C10.title: Say no politely

briefing.who: {boss} asks you to stay 2 extra hours today.
briefing.goal: Say no calmly and offer another day.

phrases: Sorry, I can't stay late today.
Sorry, can I explain what happened?
That wasn't me — I was on {area_2} then.
Це була не я, я тоді була на {area_2}

ai.en: Can you stay on till eight tonight?
Come on, we're short-staffed, it's only a couple of hours.
ai.ua: Ну давай, людей бракує, це лише пару годин.

ai.en: Fair enough. What about Thursday?

me: Sorry, I can't stay late today.
I'm sorry, I really can't today. I can do another day.
Yes, Thursday is fine.

worked: «I can do another day.»
You said no and offered something — that's fair and clear.

better.try: Sorry, I can't today. I can do Thursday.
better.why_ua: Одне «sorry» і чітке «can't» — так тебе почують.

C11.title: Take feedback

briefing.who: {boss} says you made a mistake with {task_1}.
briefing.goal: Understand what was wrong and say what you'll do.

phrases: So next time I should check {item} first?
Тобто наступного разу мені треба спершу перевірити {item}?
Sorry, could you show me the right way?

ai.en: Got a sec? About yesterday.
{item} on {area_1} were all over the shop — that can't happen again.
ai.ua: {item} на {area_1} були в повному безладі — так не можна.

ai.en: So what will you do differently?

me: Yes, of course.
OK, I understand. Sorry, could you show me the right way?
So next time I should check {item} first. Thanks for telling me.

worked: «Sorry, could you show me the right way?»
You stayed calm and asked how to fix it.

better.try: OK, I understand. Could you show me the right way?
better.why_ua: Спершу «зрозуміла», потім питання — так розмова не стає сваркою.

C12.title: Report an injury or hazard

briefing.who: {hazard_1}.
briefing.goal: Warn {boss} quickly and clearly.

phrases: Excuse me, there's something dangerous here.
Sorry, where is the first aid kit?
Do I need to fill in the accident book?
Мені треба записати це в журнал нещасних випадків?

ai.en: What's happened?
Are you OK? Where is it?
Right, don't touch it. I'll cone it off and get it logged.
ai.ua: Так, не чіпай. Я огороджу і запишу.

me: Excuse me, there's something dangerous here. {hazard_1}.
I'm OK. It's on {area_1}.
Do I need to fill in the accident book?

worked: «Excuse me, there's something dangerous here.»
You said what and where first — that's exactly right in an emergency.

better.try: Excuse me, there's something dangerous on {area_1}.
better.why_ua: Що + де — і тобі допоможуть за секунди.

F1.title: Behind on your pick rate

briefing.who: Your team leader says you're slow today.
briefing.goal: Explain why and ask for help.

phrases: What rate do I need to hit?
Sorry, could you say the number again?
Could someone show me a faster way?
Чи може хтось показати швидший спосіб?

ai.en: You're on 80 an hour, you need to be hitting 110, yeah?
ai.ua: У тебе 80 на годину, а треба 110, ясно?

ai.en: What's slowing you down?
OK, I'll get Dave to show you.

me: Sorry, could you say the number again?
Sorry, the scanner kept freezing.
Could someone show me a faster way?

worked: «Sorry, the scanner kept freezing.»
You gave the real reason — now they can help, not blame.

better.try: Sorry, the scanner kept freezing.
better.why_ua: Назви причину — це не виправдання, а факт.

F2.title: Not trained on this machine

briefing.who: You're asked to use equipment you haven't been trained on.
briefing.goal: Say no safely.

phrases: Sorry, I'm not trained on the forklift.
Вибачте, я не навчена працювати на навантажувачі.
Sorry, what did you say I should use?
Вибачте, що ви сказали мені використати?

ai.en: Just jump on the reach truck and shift those pallets.
ai.ua: Просто сідай на штабелер і перевези ті палети.

ai.en: Ah, you're not ticketed? Fair enough.
ai.ua: А, у тебе немає допуску? Гаразд.

me: Sorry, what did you say I should use?
Sorry, I'm not trained on it. Can I get the training?

worked: «Sorry, I'm not trained on the forklift.»
You said no to something unsafe — that protects you and everyone.

better.try: Sorry, I'm not trained on it. Can someone else do it?
better.why_ua: Поясни чому — і «ні» звучить професійно.

K1.title: Shift handover

briefing.who: The night carer tells you about residents.
briefing.goal: Understand and check one detail.

phrases: How was Mrs Brown last night?
Does she need anything this morning?
Sorry, could you repeat the time?
Is it in the care notes?

ai.en: Room 4 was unsettled, had PRN at two, obs are fine, she's on a fluid chart.
ai.ua: Кімната 4 була неспокійна, о другій дали ліки за потреби, показники в нормі, ведемо облік рідини.

me: Sorry, could you repeat the time?
Is it in the care notes?

worked: «Sorry, could you repeat the time?»
You checked the detail that matters — that keeps residents safe.

better.try: Sorry, could you repeat the time?
better.why_ua: Перепитай саме деталь — так швидше і впевненіше.

K2.title: Talking to a resident's family

briefing.who: A daughter asks how her mum is.
briefing.goal: Answer kindly and send her to the nurse for medical questions.

phrases: I'll ask the nurse to talk to you.
Я попрошу медсестру з вами поговорити.
Sorry, could you say that again?
Is there anything else I can do?
Чи можу я ще чимось допомогти?

ai.en: Is she eating? She looked thin on Sunday.
ai.ua: Вона їсть? У неділю здавалася худою.

ai.en: And has the GP been round about her meds?
ai.ua: А лікар приходив щодо її ліків?

me: She ate well today.
I'll ask the nurse to talk to you.

worked: «I'll ask the nurse to talk to you.»
You were kind and stayed in your role — that's exactly right.

better.try: I'll ask the nurse to talk to you.
better.why_ua: Не «не знаю», а «попрошу того, хто знає».

H1.title: A guest or customer complains

briefing.who: A guest says the food is late.
briefing.goal: Apologise, offer help, and call the manager if needed.

phrases: Let me get that sorted for you.
Sorry, could you say the table number again?

ai.en: This is ridiculous, we've been waiting forty minutes for our mains.
ai.ua: Це смішно, ми чекаємо основні страви сорок хвилин.

me: I'm sorry about that. Let me get that sorted for you.
I'll ask my manager now.

worked: «Let me get that sorted for you.»
You apologised once and moved to a solution.

better.try: I'm sorry about that. Let me get that sorted for you.
better.why_ua: Гостю потрібне рішення, а не винуватий.

H2.title: Help a customer find something

briefing.who: A customer asks where an item is.
briefing.goal: Help them find it or say when it's back.

phrases: It's in aisle 5, next to the bread.
Sorry, which one do you mean?
We've run out, sorry. It's back on Friday.

ai.en: Hiya, d'you have any of them gluten-free wraps, the big ones?
ai.ua: Привіт, у вас є безглютенові лаваші, великі?

me: Sorry, which one do you mean?
Let me show you.

worked: «Let me show you.»
You walked them there — that's great service.

better.try: It's in aisle 5, next to the bread. Let me show you.
better.why_ua: Місце + орієнтир — і людина знайде сама.

B1.title: Toolbox talk

briefing.who: Morning safety briefing on site.
briefing.goal: Understand the main risk today and ask one question.

phrases: So the main risk today is the crane?
Sorry, could you say that slower?
Do I need to sign the RAMS?

ai.en: Crane's lifting on the east side from ten, so nobody under the load, harnesses on above two metres.
ai.ua: З десятої кран піднімає на східній стороні, тож ніхто під вантажем, вище двох метрів — у страховці.

me: Sorry, could you say that slower?
Where's the exclusion zone?

worked: «Where's the exclusion zone?»
You asked about the one thing that keeps you safe today.

better.try: So the main risk today is the crane, right?
better.why_ua: Повтори ризик своїми словами — так видно, що ти зрозуміла.

B2.title: Refuse unsafe work

briefing.who: You're asked to work at height without a harness.
briefing.goal: Say no and ask for the right kit.

phrases: Sorry, I'm not going up without a harness.
Вибачте, я не полізу без страховки.
Can we get the right kit first?
I'm happy to do it once it's safe.
Я охоче зроблю, коли буде безпечно.

ai.en: It's two minutes' work, just nip up and do it.
ai.ua: Там роботи на дві хвилини, просто швиденько залізь і зроби.

me: Sorry, I'm not going up without a harness.
I'm happy to do it once it's safe.

worked: «I'm happy to do it once it's safe.»
You said no and showed you're willing — that's professional.

better.try: Sorry, I'm not going up without a harness.
better.why_ua: Назви, чого бракує, — так «ні» стає конкретним.

I1.title: Tell me about yourself

briefing.who: A recruiter starts the interview.
briefing.goal: Introduce yourself in 2–3 sentences.

phrases: I've worked in {sector_job} for two years.
I'm reliable and I learn fast.
На мене можна покластися, і я швидко вчуся.
Sorry, could you repeat the question?
Я шукаю роботу на повний день.

ai.en: So, tell me a bit about yourself.
And what made you leave your last place?
ai.ua: А чому ви пішли з попередньої роботи?

me: I've worked in {sector_job} for two years. I'm reliable and I learn fast.
Sorry, could you repeat the question?

worked: «I'm reliable and I learn fast.»
Short and clear — recruiters remember that.

better.try: I'm reliable and I learn fast.
better.why_ua: Два прикметники про себе — краще, ніж «good worker».

I2.title: Availability and shifts

briefing.who: The recruiter asks when you can work.
briefing.goal: Say your availability and check the contract.

phrases: I can work nights and weekends.
Я можу працювати ночами і на вихідних.
Sorry, is that a zero-hours contract?
Вибачте, це контракт без гарантованих годин?
How many hours a week is it?

ai.en: It's four on, four off, earlies and lates, are you flexible?
ai.ua: Чотири дні через чотири, ранні й пізні зміни — ви гнучкі?

me: Sorry, is that a zero-hours contract?
I can work nights and weekends. I can start on Monday.

worked: «How many hours a week is it?»
You asked about the contract — that's smart, not rude.

better.try: I can work nights and weekends.
better.why_ua: Конкретні дні звучать надійніше, ніж «будь-коли».

I3.title: Your questions at the end

briefing.who: The interview is ending.
briefing.goal: Ask about pay and next steps, and thank them.

phrases: Sorry, when will I hear back?

ai.en: Any questions for us?
ai.ua: У вас є питання до нас?

ai.en: We'll be in touch end of the week, all being well.
ai.ua: Ми зв'яжемося наприкінці тижня, якщо все буде добре.

me: What's the hourly rate? Is there training?
Thank you for your time.

worked: «Thank you for your time.»
You ended politely — that's the last thing they remember.

better.try: Is there training?
better.why_ua: Одне питання показує, що тобі не байдуже.

D1.title: GP appointment

briefing.who: You call the GP surgery.
briefing.goal: Book an appointment and explain the problem.

phrases: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment, please.
Добрий день, я хочу записатися на прийом.
I've had a bad back for a week.
У мене вже тиждень болить спина.

ai.en: Have you tried the online form? Otherwise it's a callback from the duty doctor.
ai.ua: Ви пробували онлайн-форму? Інакше вам передзвонить черговий лікар.

me: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment, please. I've had a bad back for a week.
Is there anything earlier?

worked: «I've had a bad back for a week.»
You said what and how long — that's what the receptionist needs.

better.try: I've had a bad back for a week.
better.why_ua: «For a week» показує, що це серйозно.

D2.title: At the bank

briefing.who: You want to open an account.
briefing.goal: Ask what documents you need.

phrases: I'd like to open an account.
Sorry, could you say that slower?

ai.en: We'll need proof of address, so a utility bill or a council tax letter.
ai.ua: Нам потрібне підтвердження адреси: рахунок за комуналку або лист про муніципальний податок.

me: What documents do I need?
Sorry, could you say that slower? Can I do it online?

worked: «What documents do I need?»
One clear question saves a second trip.

better.try: I'd like to open an account. What documents do I need?
better.why_ua: «I'd like…» + питання — ввічливо і зрозуміло.

D3.title: Call from your child's school

briefing.who: The school calls you.
briefing.goal: Find out what happened and agree when you'll come.

phrases: Sorry, I didn't understand — what happened?
Вибачте, я не зрозуміла — що сталося?

ai.en: Nothing to worry about, she's just a bit poorly, could someone collect her?
ai.ua: Нічого страшного, вона трохи нездужає — чи може хтось її забрати?

me: Hello, this is Anna's mum. Is everything OK?
Sorry, I didn't understand — what happened? I can come at four.

worked: «Sorry, I didn't understand — what happened?»
You asked again instead of guessing — exactly right with school.

better.try: Sorry, I didn't understand — what happened?
better.why_ua: Перепитати — краще, ніж хвилюватися здогадками.

designer_note: Поле designer перелічує, що дописано дизайнером: переклади реплік AI (ua), репліки користувачки для демо (me), пояснення why_ua, фідбек для уроків сфер і треків, а також What worked/Say it better, де в документі був лише один з них.
